title: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
key_facts: Google announced a 'universal' Gemini agent at its Gemini at Work event on Thursday (8 Oct 2026).
It lives in the Gemini Enterprise app, where users chat with it and assign tasks from one interface.
It can work inside Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets and Calendar, and be reached from mobile, desktop, web and third-party apps such as Slack or Microsoft 365.
It runs in the cloud, so it keeps the same context across connected devices.
Google says it can use job-specific sub-agents and act as a 'coworker agent' with its own '@agents.company.com' email.
It picks the AI model that best fits each job.
It is available only to enterprise customers in private preview.
Google launched a consumer agent, Gemini Spark, in May, with a separate interface in the Gemini app.
quote_evidence: Google is launching a “universal” Gemini AI agent that can work across apps and devices in the background.

The Gemini agent is currently only available to enterprise customers in private preview, but it may offer a glimpse into Google’s broader vision for the AI assistant that can answer questions and perform work for you from a single window.
why_it_matters_hint: Google is trying to put one agent in front of all of a company's work apps, but only a private preview group can use it so far.
